title: convert to the same type creates a junk commit
description: pebbles convert <id> <same-type> bumps updated_at and creates a 'Convert X: bug -> bug' jj commit that changes nothing. Decision: detect the same-type conversion, do nothing except warn the user (they may have picked the wrong issue or type). Acceptance: no commit, no file change, warning message naming the current type. Test: jj_integration t18.
